Network.ftp_create.title: Create FTP Connection
Network.ftp_create.comment: Establish an FTP connection to @{host} on port @{port}, output connection as @{ftp_instance}

name.title: Username
name.tip: Login account provided by the file server

password.title: Password
password.tip: Password for the login account provided by the file server

ftp_instance.title: Save FTP Connection Object To
ftp_instance.tip: Save the created FTP connection object to a specified variable

Network.ftp_close.title: Close FTP Connection
Network.ftp_close.comment: Disconnect FTP connection @{ftp_instance} and output result to @{close_ftp}

ftp_instance.title: FTP Object
ftp_instance.tip: The FTP connection object to disconnect

close_ftp.title: Save Disconnect Result To
close_ftp.tip: Boolean indicating whether the FTP connection was successfully disconnected

Network.get_work_dir.title: Get Working Directory (FTP)
Network.get_work_dir.comment: Get the current working directory of @{ftp_instance}, output as @{get_work_dir}

Network.change_working_dir.title: Change Working Directory (FTP)
Network.change_working_dir.comment: Change working directory of FTP connection @{ftp_instance} to @{new_work_dir} and save result to @{change_work_dir}

ftp_instance.title: FTP Connection Object
ftp_instance.tip: FTP connection object whose working directory needs to be changed

new_work_dir.title: Working Directory
new_work_dir.tip: The new working directory to switch to

change_work_dir.title: Working Directory After Change
change_work_dir.tip: Output the current working directory after switching

Network.create_folder.title: Create Folder (FTP)
Network.create_folder.comment: Create folder @{folder_name} on FTP connection @{ftp_instance} and save the new folder path to @{new_folder}

ftp_instance.title: FTP Connection Object
ftp_instance.tip: FTP connection object on which to create the folder

folder_name.title: New Folder Name
folder_name.tip: Name of the folder to create

exist_type.title: When Folder Exists
exist_type.tip: Action to take when a folder with the same name already exists on the FTP server

new_folder.title: Created Folder Path
new_folder.tip: Save the created folder path to a variable

Network.get_ftp_list.title: Get Files/Folders (FTP)
Network.get_ftp_list.comment: Get the @{file_type} list from FTP connection @{ftp_instance} and save to @{get_ftp_list}

ftp_instance.title: FTP Connection Object
ftp_instance.tip: FTP connection object from which to retrieve file and folder information

file_type.title: Object to Retrieve
file_type.tip: Select the type of objects to retrieve

get_ftp_list.title: Retrieved File/Folder List
get_ftp_list.tip: Output the file/folder list from the FTP connection to a variable

Network.ftp_rename.title: Rename File/Folder (FTP)
Network.ftp_rename.comment: Rename @{file_type} @{cur_file_name||cur_folder_name} in @{ftp_instance} to @{new_file_name||new_folder_name} and save renamed path to @{rename_ftp_path}

ftp_instance.title: FTP Connection Object
ftp_instance.tip: FTP connection object on which to rename the file/folder

cur_file_name.title: Current File Name
cur_file_name.tip: Enter the file to be renamed

new_file_name.title: New File Name (without extension)
new_file_name.tip: Enter the new file name without extension

cur_folder_name.title: Current Folder Name
cur_folder_name.tip: Enter the folder to be renamed

exist_type.title: When Renamed Object Exists
exist_type.tip: Action to take when the renamed object already exists

rename_ftp_path.title: Path After Rename
rename_ftp_path.tip: Save the path of the renamed @{file_type} to a variable

Network.ftp_upload.title: Upload File/Folder (FTP)
Network.ftp_upload.comment: Upload @{file_path||folder_path} to FTP directory @{ftp_pwd} and save upload result paths to @{upload_ftp_list}

ftp_instance.title: FTP Connection Object
ftp_instance.tip: FTP connection object to upload files/folders to

ftp_pwd.title: Remote Working Directory
ftp_pwd.tip: Remote working directory for file/folder upload. Leave empty to upload to current working path

file_path.title: Files to Upload
file_path.tip: Supports single or multiple file upload. Separate multiple file names with commas, e.g.: test1.txt,test2.txt,test3.txt

folder_path.title: Folders to Upload
folder_path.tip: Supports single or multiple folder upload. Separate multiple folder names with commas, e.g.: folder1,folder2,folder3

exist_type.title: When Upload Object Exists
exist_type.tip: How to handle files/folders that already exist on the FTP server

upload_ftp_list.title: Upload List
upload_ftp_list.tip: Output the paths of uploaded files/folders on the FTP server to a variable as a list

Network.ftp_download.title: Download File/Folder (FTP)
Network.ftp_download.comment: Download @{download_file_name||download_folder_name} to local directory @{dst_path} and save downloaded paths to @{download_ftp_path}

ftp_instance.title: FTP Connection Object
ftp_instance.tip: FTP connection object to download files/folders from

download_file_name.title: Files to Download
download_file_name.tip: Supports single or multiple file download. Separate multiple file names with commas, e.g.: test1.txt,test2.txt,test3.txt

download_folder_name.title: Folders to Download
download_folder_name.tip: Supports single or multiple folder download. Separate multiple folder names with commas, e.g.: folder1,folder2,folder3

state_type.title: When Local Path Does Not Exist
state_type.tip: Action to take when the local storage path does not exist

exist_type.title: When Download Object Exists
exist_type.tip: Action to take when the downloaded file/folder already exists locally

download_ftp_path.title: Download List
download_ftp_path.tip: Output the list of downloaded file/folder paths to a variable as a list

Network.ftp_delete.title: Delete File/Folder (FTP)
Network.ftp_delete.comment: Delete @{delete_file_name||delete_folder_name} from @{ftp_instance} and output result to @{delete_ftp_result}

ftp_instance.title: FTP Connection Object
ftp_instance.tip: FTP connection object on which to delete files/folders

delete_file_name.title: Files to Delete
delete_file_name.tip: Supports single or multiple file deletion. Separate multiple file names with commas, e.g.: test1.txt,test2.txt,test3.txt

delete_folder_name.title: Folders to Delete
delete_folder_name.tip: Supports single or multiple folder deletion. Separate multiple folder names with commas, e.g.: folder1,folder2,folder3

delete_ftp_result.title: Delete Result
delete_ftp_result.tip: Output the delete result to a variable

Network.http_request.title: HTTP Request
Network.http_request.comment: Send HTTP @{request_type} request to URL @{url} with headers @{headers} and body @{body}, save response to @{http_response}

save_type.title: Save Response to File
save_type.tip: Save the response to a specified text file

save_path.title: File Save Directory
save_path.tip: Enter the directory to save the file

save_name.title: File Name
save_name.tip: Enter the save file name. Default is a text file

Network.http_download.title: HTTP Download
Network.http_download.comment: Download file from URL @{url} to directory @{dst_dir} and save download path to @{http_download_path}

rename.title: Specify File Name
rename.tip: If not specified, the default file name from the URL is used. An error is raised if no default file name is available

state_type.title: When Directory Does Not Exist
state_type.tip: How to handle a missing file save directory

exist_type.title: When File Exists
exist_type.tip: How to handle an existing destination file

http_download_path.title: Save Downloaded File To
http_download_path.tip: Save the downloaded file path to a variable
